What is Zalo-Flow? Zalo-Flow is an open-source, local-first personal Zalo automation software (MIT + Commons Clause) that turns standard Zalo accounts into 24/7 AI-powered chatbots without requiring costly Zalo Official Account (OA) fees. Powered by Google Gemini and DeepSeek, it features 3-layer anti-ban protection, local AES-256 encryption, and Chatwoot CRM integration.

Everything You Need To Automate Personal Zalo

Automatically detects shared contact cards (chat.contact), strips raw JSON artifacts, normalizes Vietnamese phone numbers into 0xxxxxxxxx, and stores them neatly.

Intuitive Web Dashboard

Control your workspace at localhost:3000. View threads, jump into live customer conversations, manage contacts, and organize leads with colored tags.

📢

Targeted Remarketing & Spintax

Schedule automated follow-ups by tag. Built-in Spintax engine {Hello|Hi|Greetings} randomizes text phrasing to prevent pattern repetition.

Intelligent memory watchdog (< 350MB ceiling). Automatically drains pending outbound messages and checkpoints the SQLite database before gracefully recycling.

Questions & Answers

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Detailed answers about installation, operations, privacy, and account security.

What is Zalo-Flow and is it completely free?
Zalo-Flow is open-source software (MIT + Commons Clause) that is 100% free forever. It transforms any personal Zalo account into an automated AI assistant without requiring business licenses or recurring subscription fees.
Will my personal Zalo account get banned using this chatbot?
Zalo-Flow integrates an immutable 3-layer anti-ban defense: Token Bucket Rate Limiting (minimum 3s interval, max 20 msgs/min), Self-Echo Shield preventing conversational feedback loops, and an Inbound Flood Detector that temporarily mutes incoming storms. You should strictly reply in-thread and avoid cold spam messaging.
Does Zalo-Flow read or steal my passwords and private messages?
Never. The entire Zalo-Flow source code is publicly audited on GitHub. The software runs 100% locally on your machine, with session cookies and API keys encrypted via military-grade AES-256-CBC in a local SQLite file. Zero telemetry or user data is dispatched to external servers.
Does the bot stay active when my computer is shut down or sleeps?
Because Zalo-Flow runs locally on your PC, the background process pauses when your computer shuts down or enters sleep mode. For uninterrupted 24/7 operation, configure your PC to "Never Sleep" while plugged in, or deploy Zalo-Flow using Docker on a low-cost Linux VPS.
Which AI models does Zalo-Flow support?
Zalo-Flow supports multiple leading providers: Google Gemini (ultra-fast free Gemini 1.5 Flash), DeepSeek (DeepSeek-Chat, Reasoner), OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini), and local offline LLMs via Ollama.
